# Illyrian Plumber

Licensed NJ Master Plumber serving East Brunswick and all of Middlesex County, New Jersey since 2010. 24/7 emergency plumbing, water heater repair, boiler service, gas line installation, whole-house repiping, water filtration, and sump pump services.

## Typical pricing in East Brunswick / Middlesex County, NJ

- Diagnostic service call: from $95
- Common plumbing repair: $150 to $500
- Water heater replacement (40 to 50 gal tank): $1,500 to $3,500
- Tankless water heater installation: $2,800 to $6,500
- Boiler repair: $250 to $1,200
- Gas line repair or install: $300 to $1,500
- Emergency / after-hours plumbing: $150 to $450
- Sump pump installation: $600 to $1,800

All quotes are written and approved before work starts. No hidden trip charges or shop fees. Permits pulled from the relevant Construction Office and inspection costs included.
